card.name: Words right after avoid or do not
card.fires_on: The word or ending just after a prohibition such as "Avoid", "Do not" or "don't", often "use", "in" or "with". It appears in label warnings and instructions.

modes.label: After Avoid
modes.description: The word following "Avoid" in a warning, such as "use", "in" or the start of a drug name.
modes.example: Cerebral Malaria Avoid corticosteroids, including prednisolone sodium phosphate orally disintegrating tablets,<< in>> patients with cerebral malaria.

modes.label: After Do not
modes.example: Do not<< use>> if the solution is not clear or particles

modes.label: Negative contraction or incompatibility
modes.description: The 't' of don't, or "with" after "not compatible".
modes.example: Daptomycin for Injection is not compatible<< with>> dextrose-containing diluents.

card.plain: It marks the spot right after a warning like "avoid" or "do not", where the thing to avoid comes next.
